# QR Code Generator

`qrcode.js` is vendored, unmodified, from Kazuhiko Arase's
[qrcode-generator](https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator),
`js/dist/qrcode.js`, Git blob `df13f829bf41f36b82f0ed85751ed3b4c39cfeb8`.
Its MIT license is included in `qrcode.LICENSE`.

It runs locally when a release has an APK with a GitHub SHA-256 digest but no
published provisioning QR image. No external QR-generation service is used.
